data.one_liner: Fully configurable native splash screen plugin for Linux, Windows, and macOS apps.
data.what_it_does: Delivers fully configurable and animated native splash screens on Linux, Windows, and macOS. It uses compile-time asset generation via a CLI tool and native runtime APIs for fast startup visuals without first-frame jank.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for Linux, Windows, or macOS
You want to eliminate first-frame jank with native startup visuals
avoid_when: You primarily need a mobile-only splash screen solution (iOS/Android)
You want a pure Dart-only solution without any CLI or native configuration steps
strengths: Eliminates first-frame jank with true native rendering on desktop platforms
Supports compile-time asset generation and runtime animations like fading
Retina display support with automatic 1x and 2x asset generation on macOS
weaknesses: Requires manual platform integration steps in CMakeLists.txt and native app entry points
Requires a separate CLI tool dependency and command executions for setup and generation
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the CLI dev dependency, running initialization and setup CLI commands, patching platform build files (CMakeLists.txt), and adding native initialization code in C++, C, or Swift depending on the target OS.
